subject.title: Newport-Mesa Unified School District Board, Trustee Area 2

text: Newport-Mesa Unified School District Trustee, Area 2

As your elected Trustee and current Vice President of the Board, I have worked to make our public schools the first choice for local families. Parent of an 11th and 8th grader who have been attending Newport-Mesa schools, I see firsthand the academic, social, and emotional challenges families are navigating today. Students need thoughtful leaders who are willing to tackle complex problems and ensure they are educated and cared for in safe and welcoming spaces.

Our family has called College Park home for more than 20 years, volunteering with CMLL, flag football and Costa Mesa High School drama and choir programs. A proud product of public schools myself, I earned a master's degree in social work from USC and lead public affairs at United Way, where I advocate every day to improve the lives of Orange County residents. I have served our community in the following roles:

Member, OC Fair and Event Center Board of Directors Vice President, Costa Mesa High School Foundation Commissioner, Costa Mesa Parks and Community Services President, Kaiser-Woodland Parent Faculty Organization

At Newport-Mesa, I have focused on improving educational outcomes for all students while making progress in district-wide community engagement, infrastructure, safety, and fiscal responsibility. My accomplishments include:

Educational Excellence: Ensured the math curriculum is aligned through K - 12th, creating a stronger pathway for college and career readiness. Implemented a new reading curriculum that has already shown positive results, increasing STAR Reading growth by more than 10 points in some schools.

Facilities: Voted for the first-ever Facilities Master Plan, making infrastructure decisions more proactive and helping avoid wasteful spending. Advocated for expanding the construction of additional shade structures and new playground equipment across our campuses.

Safety: Supported integrated security systems on all campuses and voted for a strong cell phone policy. Backed the county's first ban on e-bikes and e-motos for K - 8 students along with a requirement that students complete an E-bike/bicycle safety training program.

Fiscal Stewardship: Ensured NMUSD remains fiscally strong with a Moody's Aa1 bond rating. Our reserves exceed the state required minimum, and our budget reflects our values by putting our students first without compromising educational quality.

I am proud to be endorsed by a bipartisan coalition of parents, teachers and community leaders. My record reflects my commitment to putting students and families first while considering all perspectives before making decisions.

Respectfully, I ask for your vote.
Michelle Murphy
MurphyForNewportMesa.com

text: Attorney

I am running for the Newport-Mesa School Board because I want to improve academic outcomes for all students. Every child should leave elementary school, be able to read fluently, write clearly, and with basic math skills. These fundamentals are key to opening every door that comes later.

I will bring the perspective of a parent, an attorney, a coach, and an educator to the school board. My priorities are less screen time in classrooms, more instructional time on fundamentals, and honest public reporting of how our students are performing. Math and Science programs should be chosen because evidence shows they work.

My wife and I have been married for 29 years, and we’ve lived in Costa Mesa for 27 years. We raised our four children here who all went to public schools. I have been actively involved as an educator, teaching junior high and high school. I coached wrestling and helped lead several teams to the CIF state championships. I have practiced law since 2002 in business, real estate, insurance, and professional athlete representation. I earned my law degree by attending night classes while teaching during the day.

My educational background has prepared me to enhance educational opportunities for our children, bringing the best courses in Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Math. Every child should be provided with the skills to achieve their chosen dream in college or career.

As an attorney, I will bring skills this board needs. I will examine agreements, purchases, and other spending line by line. The vast majority of your tax dollars need to be spent in the classroom, not on bloated administration. Budgeting efficiently, we can get better results without higher taxes.
I believe the board must listen to parents, students, and our teachers. I will always make myself available to them and always work to improve the academic opportunities and outcomes for all.
Holiday4NewportMesa.com
